name: Market
description: One market the team works in: its size, split into segments with sourced numbers that give TAM, SAM and SOM and that a person approves before use outside, and a map of where named organisations and Powerhouse stand on two chosen axes.

global.schema:
type MarketState {
  name: String
  "Who buys, and which problem they have."
  description: String
  "Where: a country, a region, or 'EU'."
  geography: String
  "EUR for a new market."
  currency: Currency
  "Years the obtainable market (SOM) is counted over."
  horizonYears: Int
  segments: [Segment!]!
  "Published figures beside the computed ones, as a cross-check."
  publishedFigures: [PublishedFigure!]!
  axes: MapAxes
  players: [Player!]!
  "Where Powerhouse stands on this market's map."
  us: OurPosition
  "Whether a person has approved the figures for use outside the team."
  sizeStatus: SizeStatus!
  sizeApprovedBy: EthereumAddress
  sizeApprovedAt: DateTime
}

enum SizeStatus {
  DRAFT
  APPROVED
}

"Which number of a segment a source is for."
enum SegmentFigure {
  ACCOUNTS
  ANNUAL_VALUE
}

type Segment {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  description: String
  "How many organisations are in the segment."
  accounts: Int
  accountsSource: Source
  "What one organisation is worth to us per year, in the market's currency."
  annualValue: Amount_Money
  annualValueSource: Source
  "True when we can serve the segment today: it counts towards SAM."
  serviceable: Boolean!
  "How many organisations we can win within horizonYears: SOM."
  targetAccounts: Int
  "Named organisations in the segment (Organisations records)."
  organisationIds: [PHID!]!
}

type PublishedFigure {
  id: OID!
  "What it measures, as the source says it."
  label: String!
  amount: Amount_Money!
  currency: Currency!
  year: Int
  source: Source!
}

"A source for a number: a vault note, a web page, or both."
type Source {
  title: String!
  url: URL
  documentId: PHID
}

type MapAxes {
  x: Axis!
  y: Axis!
}

type Axis {
  "What the axis measures."
  label: String!
  "The low end, at the left or bottom."
  low: String!
  "The high end, at the right or top."
  high: String!
}

type Player {
  id: OID!
  "The organisation on the map (an Organisations record)."
  organisationId: PHID!
  "0 to 100 along each axis."
  x: Float!
  y: Float!
  "Why it is placed there."
  note: String
  evidence: [VaultRef!]!
}

type VaultRef {
  id: PHID!
  title: String!
}

type OurPosition {
  x: Float!
  y: Float!
  note: String
  "The Playbook positioning statement this position stands for, if any."
  positioningId: OID
}
global.initialValue: {"name": null, "description": null, "geography": null, "currency": "EUR", "horizonYears": 3, "segments": [], "publishedFigures": [], "axes": null, "players": [], "us": null, "sizeStatus": "DRAFT", "sizeApprovedBy": null, "sizeApprovedAt": null}
